hierarchy_path.title: Advance payment of tax
hierarchy_path.retrieval_text: Chapter XIX, Division C Advance payment of tax

legal_units.title: Credit for advance tax.
legal_units.text: Any sum, other than a penalty or interest, paid by or recovered from an assessee as advance tax in pursuance of this Part shall be treated as a payment of tax in respect of the income of the tax year in which it was payable, and credit therefor shall be given to such assessee in the regular assessment.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XIX COLLECTION AND RECOVERY OF TAX Chapter XIX, Division C Advance payment of tax Section 410 Credit for advance tax. Any sum, other than a penalty or interest, paid by or recovered from an assessee as advance tax in pursuance of this Part shall be treated as a payment of tax in respect of the income of the tax year in which it was payable, and credit therefor shall be given to such assessee in the regular assessment.
